title.tr: Çapraz ayaklı kare ahşap masa, mozaik zeminde
title.en: Square timber table with crossed legs on a mosaic floor

alt.tr: Dükkan önündeki mozaik taş zeminde, tablası dikdörtgen tahtalardan yapılmış kare vernikli ahşap masa
alt.en: A square varnished timber table with a top of rectangular planks on a mosaic stone floor in front of a shop

caption.tr: Masa, alt tarafta çapraz birleşen ayaklarla duruyor. Vernik tahtaların rengini koyulaştırmış.
caption.en: The table stands on legs that cross beneath it. The varnish has deepened the colour of the boards.
